name: Snyk AI
tagline: Snyk is a developer security platform with deep AI capabilities including DeepCode AI, which uses the largest code security dataset to detect vulnerabilities in source code, and Snyk Advisor for evaluating open-source package health. It integrates into CI/CD pipelines and IDEs so security issues are caught before they reach production.
